title: When the Typewriter Sings
author: Petra Coldharbour
blurb: Rosalind Marchetti, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the ice breaks on the river.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
